findings.evidence: design.md的Manual acceptance要求在VS Code integrated terminal以CMD、Windows PowerShell 5.1與PowerShell 7 profiles執行one-line命令並確認trust與hook語意；現有EVID-002/EVID-003只記錄child-process runners，EVID-005是文件contract，EVID-006/EVID-012沒有該manual walkthrough marker。
findings.recommendation: 補記目前source fingerprint下的三個VS Code integrated terminal profile walkthrough證據，包含trust、root/nested、UTF-8、malformed、deny與read-only結果；完成前不要核准G3。
findings.title: 缺少VS Code integrated terminal walkthrough證據

findings.evidence: .agents/skills/devweave/scripts/devweave_core.py:3891-3894在非Windows直接將py-3、cmd、powershell、pwsh、hook-schema與launcher-probe設為ok=true；design.md要求標示not applicable且不得宣稱Windows certification，且POSIX python3 launcher未被實際probe。
findings.recommendation: 分離not-applicable與pass狀態並排除aggregate，或對POSIX launcher執行實際probe；保留Windows release scope限制。
findings.title: 非Windows doctor將未探測檢查回報為ok

summary: Hook、Windows launcher matrix、UTF-8/fail-closed contract與0.2.3 package證據一致；EVID-011已以相同profile取代sandbox-only EVID-010。但缺少核准的VS Code integrated terminal manual walkthrough證據，且doctor在非Windows會將未探測檢查標為ok=true，G3不可通過。
